title: A controlled path to shared AI capability
subtitle: A controlled pilot, an accountable decision.
label: Consulting
summary: A sample strategy presentation that connects an AI pilot to priorities, controls, delivery and investment.
note: Northstar Advisory is fictional. The figures are illustrative planning assumptions.

slides.title: Prove the research pilot before scaling AI
slides.claim: A $25k, 12-week research pilot makes the scale decision testable through explicit quality, adoption and value gates.

slides.title: Start where value and control readiness meet
slides.claim: Capacity hypotheses are transparent. Source readiness and review accountability determine the first release.

slides.title: Keep expert ownership at every release
slides.claim: Approved sources flow into grounded drafts, expert review and authorized delivery, with explicit correction paths.

slides.title: Run the pilot through four evidence gates
slides.claim: Four workstreams progress across four time windows, with named owners, evidence gates and dependencies.

slides.title: Release the next investment against evidence
slides.claim: The full first-year cost, ramp and three scenarios determine whether the remaining investment should be released.

process.title: Start with a decision
process.description: The outline sets out each slide’s conclusion, supporting evidence and required calculations.

process.title: Expose the assumptions
process.description: The plan records the assumptions behind the pilot’s benefits, costs and delivery schedule.

process.title: Explore the content area
process.description: The generation prompt combines the slide content, shared style and selected assets. It reserves space for headers and footers to be added in PowerPoint.

process.title: Identify meaningful editable objects
process.description: The Agent identifies the chart, tables and supporting text that need to become PowerPoint objects.

process.title: Measure the chosen regions
process.description: OpenCV measures the visible content inside the regions identified by the Agent. The overlay shows the detected boundaries.

process.title: Construct the native page
process.description: The PowerPoint objects retain the chart data, table cells and text. Selected icons are placed using their original SVG files.

process.title: Check the actual PowerPoint
process.description: This comparison shows the generated design beside the rendered PowerPoint slide.

process.title: Calibrate across the deck
process.description: The Agent compares the five slides and corrects differences in recurring titles, font sizes and decision bands. This record documents the changes.

process.title: Review the full argument
process.description: The Agent’s review records content checks, editable objects and remaining visual differences across the deck.

process.title: Edit the existing PowerPoint
process.description: A copy of the PowerPoint has an edited title and a chart value changed from 1,944 to 1,620. The comparison shows the updated bar and label.
